Rae: Hey runtime team  need a reproducible smoke + full-run for the 'demo-spark' cohort for next week's launch materials. Goal: validated latency & correctness artifacts we can hand to design and comms. Requirements:
- 1,000 samples split 40/40/20 (short/medium/long)
- Variants: fp16 baseline, int8 quant, and a rapid 4-bit probe (aq4)
